description: This file implements a digital signer for PDF documents using .NET cryptography classes, specifically handling the creation of digital signatures with optional timestamping via a timestamp authority. It defines the PdfSharpDefaultSigner class which supports signature size estimation, signing streams, and adding timestamp tokens in .NET 6.0+ environments.

classes.name: PdfSharpDefaultSigner
classes.description: Implements a PDF digital signer using .NET cryptography, supporting timestamping and signature size estimation.

methods.name: PdfSharpDefaultSigner
methods.description: Constructor initializing the signer with a certificate, digest type, and optional timestamp authority URI.

methods.name: GetSignatureSizeAsync
methods.description: Calculates and returns the size of the signature block needed for the PDF, based on digest and certificate size.

methods.name: GetSignatureAsync
methods.description: Creates a digital signature for the provided data stream, optionally adding a timestamp token.

methods.name: AddTimestampFromTSAAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a timestamp token from a TSA and embeds it into the signature, only available in .NET 6.0+.
